directives.title: Черные Бандиты с Юга
directives.title_en: The Black Bandits of the South
directives.description: Ни богов, ни хозяев, лишь деньги, алкоголь и женщины! Дирлевангер приводил нас к победе раз за разом, против сильных и слабых, и доказал России что Бригада будет брать то, что хочет! Пусть слабые трепещут, а сильные сдаются нашей орде! Настало время превратить Южный Урал в свои угодья!
directives.description_en:
Oskar Dirlewanger has led us to victory, and enrichment, against foes weak and strong, time and time again. From our 'service' within the SS, to our escape when the Wehrmacht tried to disarm us, to our capture of the lands around Orsk, he has always shown us the way.

And that way is to take. We take what we want, and we want it all. Everything in the Southern Urals - wealth, women, land - belongs to us. It just hasn't been collected yet.

We're going to correct that.

directives.title: Припёрты к стене
directives.description: Уральская Лига уже месяцами высылает охотничьи группы, и несмотря на то, что мы можем избегать или уничтожать их, им наконец-то удалось нас отследить. Нас жмут безумцы с восточной стороны, Лига и Коммуны жмут нас с севера и запада, а степи блокируют наш путь на юг. Похоже, пришло время дать бой. Эти твари даже не подозревают о том, что действуют точно по нашим предсказаниям! Мы избавимся от этих грёбаных подхалимов и пожнем плоды Оренбурга! Нам нужно лишь подготовиться...
directives.description_en:
These lands might belong to us, but not everyone accepts that. The Ural League, a pathetic collection of communities led by a criminal priest, have hunted us time and again, and though we've evaded or destroyed their parties, more always come.

Otherwise pinned between the madmen to the east, the steppes to the south, and the communes to the west, the League thinks they can destroy us once and for all. But what they don't know is that we have them right where we want them. We'll hold our own, bleed them dry and then, in time, strike back and take Orenburg.

And when we do, they will truly learn why the Brigade is so feared.

directives.title: Готовьте парней
directives.description: Готовые к любым приключениям, ребята из Бригады самые злые и отбитые парни в этой части Сибири! Накачайте бандита водкой, или еще чем покрепче, и он уничтожит всё, что стоит между ним и его выпивкой. Пришло время раздать алкоголь, девок, и готовиться к следующему набегу!
directives.description_en:
Nobody in Russia, on either side of the Urals, is meaner, tougher, or stronger than the men of the Brigade. It's time to prove that once again.

In order to provide motivation, some of the previous spoils will be spread around. Loot, liquor, and the provision of women still capable of providing entertainment will remind them of what's to come.

Our next 'expedition' is fast approaching, and they must be enthusiastic for it!

directives.title: Храните их свежими
directives.description: Нельзя дать парням потерять хватку! Как и любой другой человек, наш шеф понимает что ленивый бандит - мёртвый бандит, так как мы все помним что случилось со стариком Христмэном, и с тем мудаком с ржавыми вилами. Убедитесь в том, что постели жесткие, а погода суровая, и пока бандит согрет водкой, он будет счастлив и согрет.
directives.description_en:
The men of the Brigade are hard. But gorging on plunder, that ever present goal, has a disturbing tendency to turn them soft. A lazy bandit is a dead bandit, and we have no intention of dying.

We'll keep their beds hard, their barracks barely warm enough, and their liquor share sufficient, but only just. We'll keep them alert.

Alert enough so that, when the command is given, they will eagerly jump for the chance to participate in another 'expedition.'

directives.title: Пусть они будут довольны
directives.description: Король знает как обращаться со своими подопечными! Водка, женщины, наркота и песни! Товары из за границы и добро которое было вырвано из замерзших рук того ублюдка, которому не повезло быть найденным в тот день, украденные настольные игры из бывших школ и книги из разворованных библиотек, хотя бы для тех, кто умеет читать. Если бандит умеет развлекаться, то кому какое дело до того, как он себя чувствует? Дайте им повеселеть прежде чем они начнут убивать.
directives.description_en:
The Brigade exists because of enjoyment. Enjoyment of using that which was taken by force of arms from the cold, dead, hands of weaker men.

What 'that' is - wine, women, drugs, games, books, or anything else at all - doesn't matter. The boss knows this very well, and so loot will be distributed and revelry encouraged.

A happy bandit is always motivated to remain so, and will cheerfully obey any orders given in that pursuit.

directives.title: Готовтесь к схватке
directives.description: Схватка грядет! Мы разобьём крепости Уральских ублюдков и превратим Оренбург в нашу личную шлюху. А когда мы закончим с ними, мы нагнём весь мир! Парни должны знать, что это cерьёзная работа, потому что если мы не победим Лигу, это будет равносильно смерти?
directives.description_en:
It's coming, and soon.

A big showdown with the Ural League is approaching, and we are going to destroy them. We are going to kill their men, rape Orenburg into the ground, in every way possible, and prove to everyone that nobody can stop the Brigade!

And after that? Without the League around to organize defenses and provide 'advisors' to villages? Well, we'll loot the whole region. Who could stop us?

directives.title: Пан или Пропал
directives.description: Пан или пропал! Если Бригада не мародёрствует, значит она дерьмовая! Мы задавим любого ублюдка который думает, что он достаточно силён чтобы играть с нами в солдатиков и покажем им, что именно может сделать бандит! Готовьтесь парни, выезжаем на рейд!
directives.description_en:
Surrounded by enemies, by those who would think to stop us or end our right to plunder, we refuse to die like they so desperately hope! We take! We ride!

We ride over any man foolish enough to play soldier, over any village foolish enough to arm a militia, and over anyone else who dares to try and stop us. We'll find whatever - or whomever - they try to protect, and load it up over their corpses.

Get ready, boys! We ride for plunder!

directives.title: Готовьте Новый Рейд
directives.description: Многие думают что мы - банда простаков, которые не умеют планировать, и просто шайка преступников и головорезов которые будут красть и убивать когда захотят. Ну, они недалеки от истины, но они не понимают что каждый рейд должен быть чётко спланирован. Нужно знать как максимально увеличить потери со стороны врага, увеличить количество добычи, и свести на нет храбрость врага. Дирлевангер делал именно это с тех пор как появился в России. Настало время залечь на дно, и планировать наш новый огромный рейд!
directives.description_en:
A lot of people think that the men of the Brigade are simple bandits, capable of nothing more than simple brutality in the pursuit of plunder. Most of those people are dead.

We may be brutal, and we may want to plunder, but we are no simpletons. Raids must be planned. Loot must be transported. Casualties must be managed. Terror must be applied in just the right fashion.

Dirlewanger, and the Brigade at large, have been doing this for years. And we will continue to do so, as we prepare for the biggest raids yet!

directives.title: Собирайте нашу добычу
directives.description: Нам нужно записать то, что у нас уже есть в запасах, если мы не хотим чтобы опять какой-нибудь жадный гондопляс не украл нашу водку. Особенно, если иметь в виду то, что если мы хотим хорошо жить, то должны знать сколько у нас осталось на эту хорошую жизнь! Перепись инвентаря очень важна, но и довольно скучна, поэтому прикажем одному из казахов заняться этим.
directives.description_en:
When the Brigade rides, it always returns with mountains of loot. But it also returns with the problem of keeping track of that loot.

Shares must be properly distributed, and even with the penalty known, some men always try to take more. This cannot be allowed to continue - every man gets a share, and the size of that share depends on many things. An inventory of all spoils must be meticulously generated, kept, and regularly updated.

After all, how else will we know when it's time to go and take more?

directives.title: Готовьтесь к наградам
directives.description: Нужно освобождать место! Настало время расчистить старые склады. Мы уже примерно прикинули сколько добычи можно будет получить в следующем рейде, давайте убедимся в том, что у нас есть место куда ее можно будет положить, если конечно не хотите повторения того случая, когда нам пришлось допить шесть ящиков бухла чтобы освободить место для тех стволов, которые нашел Серов.
directives.description_en:
Though it could not truly be considered a 'problem,' we frequently find that we have trouble storing all of the spoils of our many successful raids.

This causes trouble - without proper places to store everything we've taken, not only do we need to rapidly distribute or consume it, which causes discipline problems, but we find that thievery increases besides.

Therefore, More depots will be constructed before our next raid. Hopefully, they'll fill up just as quickly!

directives.title: Чёрный Бандит Чёрной Горы
directives.title_en: The Black Bandit on the Black Mountain
directives.description: Тот чокнутый педофил который заседает на своей странной горе может стать отличным союзником. Он не является другом тех лохов из Лиги, которые восседают на своих горах. Мы не знаем что хочет этот козёл, но наслышаны о том, что у него дохрена оружия! И оно нам пригодится. Может быть нам удастся заключить сделку, а потом посмотрим, что еще у него найдётся...
directives.description_en:
Even for the men of the Brigade, rumours about the insane experiments conducted by the mad scientist in Magnitogorsk are enough to give pause. But the boss sees only opportunity.

Whatever else he might be, Lysenko is certainly no friend of the Ural League, and he has large deposits of weapons of all kinds. Weapons we want. We'll try and work out a deal for some of them.

And, in time, we can look into what else he might have...

directives.title: Инструкции от Лысенко
directives.description: Что за день, что за прекрасный день! У этого психа на горе оказалось море оружия, также у него есть несколько старых советских пердунов, которые знают как им пользоваться! Надо посмотреть что у них в башке, дабы они могли хотя бы чему-нибудь научить наших ребят. Нельзя учить старую собаку новым трюкам, но можно лупить ее пока она не поймёт где нельзя играть!
directives.description_en:
The deal with Lysenko has worked out even better than we could have hoped. Not only did he have weapons, but among the NKVD soldiers who defected to him there were several actual combat instructors.

The men of the Brigade may be expert raiders with an eye for the value of anything encountered, but many of them, especially our newer recruits, are woefully undertrained. We've therefore worked out an arrangement to send some of our people to go and learn some basic military particulars from those instructors.

Let's see how much the League likes it when we next run into them!

directives.title: Обещания Лысенко
directives.description: Лысенко очень много требует, но и много даёт взамен! Горы денег, горы алкоголя... горы? Горы женщин! Ещё посмотрим, что сможет предложить нам этот старикан, кто бы мог подумать, что все это найдется внутри Чёрной Горы!
directives.description_en:
In exchange for his help, Lysenko demands much from the Brigade. Prisoners who could be put to work - in the base or on their back - or otherwise pressed into service have to be handed over unharmed.

He's paid us well for them so far, yes, but what else does that madman have, hidden away in his labs? In the depths of the Black Mountain?

It's time to find out, and see what other items he's willing to offer!

directives.title: Грузовики с наградами
directives.description: Горы денег, алкоголя и женщин превратились в грузовики, полные алкоголя и женщин! Как ни странно, он позволил нам оставить грузовики себе. Ну что же, они пригодятся позже...
directives.description_en:
Our requests for 'alternative' forms of payment from Lysenko have borne fruit.

The first such form? Trucks, no doubt taken from the motor pool of the formations that defected alongside him. While the origin matters little to us, the effect matters much, much more. More trucks means that more gold, more grain, more women, more everything can be loaded up and brought back to our camps.

Time to find some sleepy village where they can be put to use!

directives.title: Богатства Горы
directives.description: Наверное, раз мы помогли ему во многих делах, то Лысенко будет не против... поделиться... богатствами Чёрной Горы с нами.
directives.description_en:
The Brigade continues to hand over valuable prisoners to Lysenko, and it's long past time that we remind him how valuable our continued assistance truly is.

There's more inside the Black Mountain than he's shared with us so far, much more, and we want it! A little pressure, applied in just the right way, should encourage some additional cooperation and payment.

If Lysenko knows what's good for him, anyway.

directives.title: Мыслительный Центр
directives.description: Разумеется, все те вещи которые мы получили от Лысенко хороши, но вещи есть вещи. Почему бы нам не попросить у него одного из его ботаников? Неужто им не хочется... поработать в поле.
directives.description_en:
Lysenko's given us trucks, guns, and money. So why doesn't he give us back some of what we've been giving him - people?

He's got all kinds of scientists hidden away in his labs, and some of them must be less important than the others. Why doesn't he send them to us instead? He'll get more prisoners, and we'll get some eggheads that can move to both perform some 'field research' on prisoners and contribute to our own efforts besides.

It's too good a deal to pass up. We'll make sure Lysenko sees that.

directives.title: Ограбить весь мир
directives.description: Ну что же, он решил с нами поделиться! Как мило с его стороны! Это нам пригодится в будущем!
directives.description_en:
Lysenko's made the right choices so far, giving us alternative and useful items for our prisoners, and now he's stepping up his normal payments as well!

He seems to be learning - the Brigade is happy to sell, but payment - considerable payment - is both required and expected. The latest such payment has arrived - more rifles and equipment, including heavier ordnance.

It's good stuff. Time to go use it!

directives.title: План Лысенко
directives.description: Люди, люди, люди. Это единственное, что заботит Лысенко! Он не хочет денег, наркотиков, или даже женщин... по крайней мере, для обычного их использования. Он одержим поиском новых подопытных для своих экспериментов. Он получит этих людей, а мы взамен, деньги и кровь!
directives.description_en:
People. It's all Lysenko cares about.

Money? He could care less. Territory? He has no use for it. Women? Not in the way we want them, that's for sure. No, all he wants are lots of people, marched to the Black Mountain in chains for use in whatever twisted experiments he has planned. Well, if that's what he wants, that's what he gets - as long as he can pay.

If he can, he can have the people he wants - and we can have the loot, both from them and him, that we want!

directives.title: Проверяем своих врагов
directives.description: Уральская Лига. Оренбург. Крестьяне. Все как пушечное мясо. Нас ждут завоевания, которые сравнимы только с Римской Империей, но сначала нам нужно проверить силу наших врагов, прежде чем веселье начнётся.
directives.description_en:
The Brigade is surrounded by enemies. But that also means that we are surrounded by opportunities.

The Ural League, Orenburg, and countless small villages and settlements occupy the lands around us, all rich with loot just waiting for us to take it. We must be careful, however, as they are all waiting for us to make a mistake. Therefore, we will first test their strength, and see which of our foes offers the best opportunity.

Then, and only then, will we ride to plunder!

directives.title: Нападение на Урал
directives.description: Как еще можно описать Лигу, не используя слово 'жалкие'? Быть может, мы поможем им и поставим их людей на подобающее им место - у параши
directives.description_en:
The Ural League, our most vigorous enemy.

As much as we hate their pathetic mongrel 'state,' we cannot deny that their militias are effective and their communities well protected. On several occasions in the past they have even defeated us, and this is causing us trouble. We must prove that they are not capable of defending their territory, that they, like everyone else, fall before us.

We must put them in their place. And we will.

directives.title: Нападение на Оренбург
directives.description: Оренбург - это ни что иное как маленькая группа жалких 'коммун' которые до сих пор были больше под давлением Лиги, нежели нашим. Пришло время это изменить.
directives.description_en:
The communes of Orenburg are disorganized and only loosely held together by shared anarchist ideals. In other words, they are perfect targets.

Up until now, however, they have been the targets of our raids far less than the villages and settlements of the Ural League. This means that, unlike the places we have sacked before, they must be swollen with loot.

Time to show them what the Brigade can do!

directives.title: Удар по крестьянам
directives.description: Ах, процесс убийства крестьян стар, как сам мир. Небольшой риск и небольшая награда, но это определённо весело!
directives.description_en:
Though striking at settlements affiliated with either the League or Orenburg could yield good loot, there is one major problem: they can fight back.

Though that usually isn't a problem, right now we'd rather not risk a defeat. The independent villages that dot the Southern Urals might not be wealthy, but they also have no real defenses. There won't be much loot, but there will be some, as well as women besides.

That will be enough for now.

directives.title: Выманите Гвардию
directives.description: Уральская Гвардия стояла на нашем пути слишком долго! Несколько рейдов смогут выманить их и показать их слабые места ...
directives.description_en:
At every turn, the Ural Guard frustrates our efforts, organizing defenses, training villagers into militia, and even striking at our camps in the night.

If we're going to, one day, utterly destroy them, and leave their lands open for plunder, we need to sap their strength first, and the maskirovka tactics we have recently learned can help here. A series of small raids should force them to commit their main force to action.

And when they do, we will be waiting.

directives.title: Хватайте молодых, здоровых и сильных
directives.title_en: Grab the Healthy, Fit and Strong
directives.description: Мы грабим не только ради золота и крови, намного ценее люди. Каждый человек которого мы захватываем является потенциальным сотрудником для нас - они либо преклонятся, либо умрут!
directives.description_en:
We raid for wealth, entertainment, and many other reasons, but one of the most valuable things we find is flesh.

Every single person we take captive during a raid can be utilized. Women can be used until they can be used no more, and men can either be put to work or, if they are strong enough, pressed into service. All can serve.

And they will serve. Or they will die.

directives.title: Бои за Новотроицк
directives.description: Наш план сработал! Уральская гвардия попала в нашу ловушку,торопливо возводя оборону города Новотроицка и готовясь отразить слабое сопротивление. Они обосрутся, поняв как мы их наебали.
directives.description_en:
Our gambit worked!

The raids we conducted on the League's outlying villages have drawn them out, moving to erect defenses around the town on Novotroitsk in anticipation of an engagement. But they still think they will only be fighting another raiding force, and have deployed themselves accordingly.

They have no idea what's coming.

directives.title: Великолепный Инструктаж
directives.description: Да, мы победили Красных уже несколько месяцев назад, но мы не можем отрицать тот факт, что они достойно боролись. Их методы были довольно брутальными, а это именно то, что нам нужно в предстоящих схватках.
directives.description_en:
The Soviets might have lost their grand war against the Reich, but those of us still around from those times well remember how hard they fought, and how many Germans they killed, before capitulating.

They accomplished this through tough, uncompromising, and sometimes brutal training. Training that we now have access to, courtesy of Lysenko's instructors. And we intend to exploit it. As many of our men as possible will be sent to, hopefully, learn better and more efficient tactics.

If those tactics lead to more successful raids, so much the better.

directives.title: Советское Оружие
directives.description: Старые пушки конечно, старые, но это всё-таки оружие. А кому блять не нравится оружие!? Давайте отдадим это старье парням помоложе, дабы Соколову не пришлось убивать всяких сволочей грёбаной лопатой.
directives.description_en:
Many of the weapons secured for the Brigade from Lysenko's Magnitogorsk stockpiles are ancient beyond all measure. Some even bear the double-headed Russian Imperial Eagle!

But guns are guns, and as long as they can reliably shoot, they can be of value. We will distribute them to the men of the Brigade, starting with the newest recruits, freeing up better weapons for the veterans. If they prove themselves, and turn over the loot they find for distribution as is required, they can earn themselves a better weapon.

And if they don't, there's always another recruit waiting.

directives.title: Советские Стратегии
directives.description: Несмотря на то, что коммуняки не так давно продули нам, оказалось что у них остались несколько тузов в рукаве, которые им не удалось выложить. Большинство из них для нас будет невозможно повторить, но с небольшими изменениями мы с легкостью сможем их интегрировать в нашем следующем набеге.
directives.description_en:
The Soviets lost, but as the Russian members of the Brigade make sure to constantly emphasize, they were, and are, masters of deception. Of the maskirovka.

They used that mastery, many years ago, to sow confusion among both the Wehrmacht and their other enemies. Our enemies are smaller than the Soviets' were, but they are enemies all the same. If we can learn some of these strategies of deception, modify them to suit our purposes, and deploy them on our next raid, we could increase effectiveness significantly.

Or, at the very least, give them less time to hide their valuables.

directives.title: Советское Мастерство
directives.description: Совместив наши лично созданные тактики, и то, о чем так много говорят эти старики, у нас все налаживатеся! Немного обхода с флангов, немного быстрой борьбы, для нас такие методы не новы, однако теперь мы можем использовать все это во многих новых ситуациях и комбинациях! Кому не терпится попробовать? Я знаю что нам всем не терпится! Поэтому давайте в бой!
directives.description_en:
The Brigade has survived - and thrived - by understanding its environment. When we broke away from Germany, we had to adapt our doctrine, altering it to suit the Urals and our needs for raiding.

With our new deal in place, Lysenko's instructors are imparting to us Soviet tactics. Some of the smarter men have realized that combining the two - Soviet strength and discipline with the unorthodoxy and unpredictability of raiding maneuvers - could give us a real advantage over those who would see us destroyed.

So we will.

directives.title: Вторая Фаза
directives.description: Сейчас гвардия прибывает в шоке потерпев поражение при битве под Новотроицком, тем временем мы воспользуемся нашими преимуществами в их рядах, чтобы начать набеги на ряд их крепостей, оставленных в суматохе, пока основные силы готовятся к нашему следующему великому рейду!
directives.description_en:
The Ural League's forces were smashed at Novotroitsk, drawn in by our deception, and this gives us an opportunity.

Their militias are depleted, their defensive lines breached, and their fortresses exposed. We will likely not see such momentary weakness again, and we must move to take advantage. Additional raids will be launched on these fortresses to ensure their destruction.

Another great raid approaches, and when it does, the League will not be able to interfere!

directives.title: Гвардейские Уроки
directives.description: Если мы ничего не извлечем из нашего опыта с уральскими гвардейцами, мы совершим огромную ошибку. Мы должны заставить их учить нас своей тактике под страхом смерти.
directives.description_en:
We secured much loot from the League's fortresses, but we also took prisoners.

Though we would usually hand them over to Lysenko, or just dispose of them altogether, we should not forget how useful the training our men previously received was. We'll give them a very simple choice: teach us how the League trains and fights, or die. Surely, some of them will be willing to give us lessons.

And then we can, and will, use those lessons against their former friends.

directives.title: Перевезите народ
directives.description: На самом деле у нас не хватает места для всех заключённых, которых мы захватываем в рейдах.Их нужно передавать Лысенко, причём срочно.
directives.description_en:
Our raids in the Southern Urals, having expanded both in frequency and scale, have left us with many more captives than usual.

We don't have the space, or the desire, to hold onto them, and we certainly don't want to feed them. But, as always, Lysenko always wants more, and so we'll move to hand them off to him. For proper compensation, of course.

Let's see what we can pressure him for this time.

directives.title: Второй Великий Рейд
directives.description: Пришло время готовиться ко Второму Великому Рейду. Нужно только спланировать - кто, где, когда...
directives.description_en:
With the Ural League humbled after their debacle at Novotroitsk, it's time to plan for another great raid. One that they won't be able to stop.

There are many questions to answer first, however. Where to target? What type of loot to concentrate on? When to attack? What to do with the captives - at least once the men are done with them?

We will, however, find answers. An abundance of choice is something we could get used to!

directives.title: Собирайте парней
directives.description: Дайте парням то, чего они хотят! Пообещайте им богатсва, женщин, алкоголь и всё, что они сами смогут награбить, и они сами будут рваться в бой!
directives.description_en:
If we're going to raid, we need to get the men pumped up!

We'll tell the officers to promise them whatever they want - money, women, liquor, blood, anything! Whether they get it or not is up to them, up to how aggressive, violent, and perceptive they are. And, of course, once they do find any such items, they'll have to put them in inventory, to be properly distributed.

But they'll get their share. The share they deserve.

directives.title: Поделиться добычей
directives.description: Разве это было сложно? Теперь у нас есть бухло, женщины и деньги! Раздайте бухло, раздвиньте ноги бабам, потратьте деньги, и вообще, делайте все, что хотите ребята!
directives.description_en:
Our raid was a great success, and we've come away with even more plunder than we thought!

It's time to spread the wealth around, and maybe this time we increase their share a bit. Give them a little more liquor, a few more pieces of gold, one or two more women to use up, and free rein over some of the other prisoners and items.

Some of our officers might be a little unhappy, but even they have to know that keeping the men happy is an important consideration!

directives.title: Зализываем Раны
directives.description: Так парни, настало время сделать небольшой перерыв. Нам нужно сделать передышку перед следующими рейдами. Вы все заслужили небольшой отпуск.
directives.description_en:
Our raids were successful, but that doesn't mean they were without cost.

Men were lost, as they always are. Equipment was worn out, camps abandoned, and the like. We're going to be going out again soon, of course, but only a fool acts without preparation. So we'll take a break. We'll rest, repair, and identify new targets.

And then we'll head right back out again.

directives.title: Далеко на западе
directives.description: Итак, вариант первый: Оренбург до сих пор "свободный" город. Они даже не подозревают: что такое свобода! Поэтому предлагаю устроить им демонстрацию, а заодно и повеселиться!
directives.description_en:
To the west lies Orenburg. A perfect target.

Their defenses are chaotic and uncoordinated, their militias are not nearly as effective as those of the Ural League, and their settlements are laden with loot ripe for harvest. With so many factors in our favor, why wouldn't we target them next? We will prepare our raiding party immediately.

Time to ride!

directives.title: Пробиться на гору
directives.description: Вариант номер 2: Уральская Гвардия мешается нам на каждом шаге! Это будет сложный рейд, но награда будет стоить того!
directives.description_en:
Once again, we look at the lands of the Ural League for our next raid.

They still haven't recovered fully from their defeat at Novotroitsk, and they still oppose us at every turn. They remain our most formidable enemies, but the air of strength that they once possessed has dissipated considerably. We'll hit them again, while they're still down, and carry away whatever they have left.

And we'll prove to the people of the Southern Urals that the League can't protect them from us!

directives.title: Уральский Опыт
directives.description: Эй,а эти ребята которых мы захватили довольно неплохо умеют убивать. Если мы заставим этих парней работать на нас, то мы точно не пожалеем!
directives.description_en:
The Ural League captives, those smart enough to take us up on our offer at least, have been very helpful.

The lands of the League are rugged and mountainous, and they've given us some useful instruction on how to best handle them. So useful, in fact, that some of the Brigade think they should be given an offer to stay, and join us more permanently.

They can always refuse, of course. It just means we need to dig a slightly bigger hole.

directives.title: Самодельная Броня
directives.description: Если аккуратно закрепить кусочки метала вокруг нашего тела то из этого можно сделать вполне неплохую броню. Мы должны это использовать!
directives.description_en:
There is one thing that the men have been asking for, time and time again: body armor.

Though we don't have the connections or resources to acquire proper, high-quality armor, we don't need to. Most of the weapons our enemies use are old or improvised, and so we can improvise a solution as well. We have lots of scrap metal lying around, from old or plundered equipment, and we can use it to fashion sets of crude armor.

It will be good enough. If a bit strange looking.

directives.title: Волчья Сотня
directives.description: По натуре волки прекрансые охотники, и мы последуем их опыту; как волки, мы должны атаковать маленькими стаями, и через серию быстрых атак ломать нашу жертву.
directives.description_en:
There's much to admire about wolves.

They hunt in packs. They identify the best targets of opportunity, targets that foolishly remove themselves from the larger herd. They move swiftly, achieve their goal, and then withdraw, ready to repeat the procedure all over again. We should act in the same fashion, using our trucks to move rapidly, bring down our prey, and take what we want.

Soon, all will know the Brigade as the Wolves of the Urals.

directives.title: Передавайте Их
directives.description: Лысенко предложил нам своё оборудование взамен на захваченных людей для своих экспериментов. Как и раньше.
directives.description_en:
As before, Lysenko has offered to provide us with a reasonable amount of equipment from the Black Mountain's stockpiles in exchange for the captives we can offer.

While some within the Brigade claim we should push him for more, citing our strengthening position, others claim that Lysenko's realm isn't comparable to that of our usual targets, and that there is little purpose in killing a golden goose besides.

Their argument has merit. We'll stick to the deal. For now.

directives.title: Правила меняются
directives.description: У нас больше людей чем у него. Мы должны сосредоточиться на давлении на безумца Черной Горы, чтобы он дал нам больше чем мы просили изначально...
directives.description_en:
The last time we arranged a major deal with Lysenko, we weren't powerful enough to strong arm him. That is no longer the case.

We have more men than him. We have more experience than him. And, after all our previous deals, it's very possible that we now have more equipment than him as well. It's time to make this difference in position clear. He can give more. We'll tell him as much.

And he had better do so.

directives.title: Хорошие друзья, хорошие деньги
directives.description: Лысенко, уж сколько правды в этом слове, для Дирлевангера сбылось, настолько и правдивы наши слова о том, что мы дадим ему новый материал. А он сделает нашу жизнь чуть полегче, дав снарягу для более прекрасного вырезания людей на вражьей территории!
directives.description_en:
True to his word, and in response to our own actions, Lysenko has stuck to the deal as well.

Already, shipments of equipment, as agreed upon, approach our depots outside Orsk. Though it's not as much as some claim we should have gotten, it is a lot more than nothing, and can immediately be put to use in our future raids. That will have to be good enough for the moment.

But next time? Who knows?

directives.title: Молись чтобы правила не менялись дальше
directives.title_en: Pray We Don't Alter It Further
directives.description: ...и это, он должен надеяться на то, чтобы мы не попросили еще, так как он будет под ударом если не даст нам то, чего мы хотим.
directives.description_en:
Excellent news - Lysenko has realized he was in no position to bargain with the Brigade, and he backed down like the coward we know he is.

Already shipments of equipment, much more than we might have received otherwise, approach our depots outside Orsk. Our men are excited in the extreme to get their hands on them, to replace both old and worn out weapons and to equip our newest recruits as well. We've already begun planning more raids to make use of them.

Whoever said intimidation couldn't work wonders?

directives.title: Клешня
directives.description: Вариант третий: Мы нападаем на обоих, и обворовываем! Это будет нелегко, но если у нас получится, то Гвардия ослабеет, а у нас будет много баб, денег, и бухла!
directives.description_en:
There exists a third option: strike Orenburg and the Ural League together, at the same time!

Such a move will be difficult, and a great risk besides, but if we win, if we defeat and scatter their forces both, we will have more plunder, of all kinds, than we will know what to do with. Not only that, we will strike fear into all of the Southern Urals.

The Brigade cannot be stopped, and we will prove it!

directives.title: Пожинать плоды
directives.description: Мы сожгли всю Центральную Россию, но ради чего? Ради наград - женщин наркотиков и золота, вот ради чего! Можно расслабиться и насладиться добычей сполна - вы это заслужили!
directives.description_en:
We've spent the last while taking everything in the Southern Urals that wasn't nailed down - and some things that were!

It's time to take a moment and enjoy what we've accomplished. Life is about more than raiding, after all - its also about enjoying the wine and women that come along with it! Make sure to use it, and them, all up!

We can, and will, always go and get more!

directives.title: Готовьтесь к Финальной Битве
directives.description: Уральская Гвардия является последним препятствием на пути к полному контролю над этой землей. Один последний удар, чтобы уничтожить этих трусов это всё, что нам нужно.
directives.description_en:
The time has come.

We've hit the Ural League over and over, and still they stand. Still they fight us at every opportunity. Still they, maddeningly, give the people hope that they can stand against us. Against the Brigade! No longer. We will prepare one final strike, to end those cowards for good.

And once they're gone, the people who have thought themselves long safe under their protection will learn what we're really capable of!

directives.title: Под звуки Горна
directives.description: Мы потратили годы, просиживая штаны в этой гнили и дикости, страдая от атак наших приятелей, которых на родине именуют командирами, так и от наших сыкливых Русских соседей. Мы используем страх. Но не долго. Рано или поздно наши соседи станут сильны и время просиживания штанов закончится. Это время для Великой Охоты, со звуком горна для наших Предков как и для нас сейчас началась и начнется великая бойня!УБИВАТЬ!
directives.description_en:
We've spent years in these lands around Orsk, suffering attacks from all sides.

From our former so-called comrades in the Fatherland. From our cowardly Russian neighbors. From pathetic villagers who dare to strike back. No longer. We have grown strong, and they have grown weak. The time of inaction is over. It is time to sound the horn.

Let the hunt begin! Charge!

directives.title: Барабанная Дробь
directives.description: Звук барабанной дроби должен их напугать! Они знают, что мы идем и им нас не остановить! УХАХАХАХАХАХАХА!
directives.description_en:
We are coming for our enemies, and we must let them know it.

We will exercise our men, in full view of those we know are watching, and make it clear that we are preparing for plunder, slaughter, and anything else besides. We will proclaim, proudly, that we are about to march, and that nothing they do, nothing they say, and nothing they offer, will save them from what's to come.

They're already dead. They just don't know it yet.

directives.title: Готовьте наших парней
directives.description: Я понимаю, что вам на протяжении нескольких дней уже очень весело - вы пьете, трахаетесь и напичкиваете дргуг друга наркотой, но пришло время приостановиться. Нам нужно быть готовыми к нашей последней атаке на Гвардию.
directives.description_en:
If there's one thing the damnable Ural League has in spades, its manpower.

Refugees from across the Southern Urals and beyond flow into the League's lands, and more than a few of them join up in an attempt to 'protect' their families. If we're going to win, we need everyone to be ready. Discipline must be enforced, and every man of the Brigade must be roused, pulled from between the legs of their latest conquest, or returned from whatever personal grudge they've left to settle.

The showdown is approaching.

directives.title: Собирайте Оружие
directives.description: Сука, я знал что этим пидорам нельзя доверять оружие и склад. Давайте мужики, поднажмем. Нам нужны эти пушки в рабочем состоянии!
directives.description_en:
Any major fight with the League is going to require every weapon we have.

To say that the men of the Brigade are hard on their equipment would be a colossal understatement, and so we must make sure that every weapon we do have is working, assigned to a fighter, and in peak condition as well.

We can leave nothing to chance when we go after the League - we'll only have one chance.

directives.title: Уважайте Договор
directives.description: У нас был договор с Лысенко. Мы конечно воры, но уважаем друг друга, а так же уважаем сделки которые заключали до этого.
directives.description_en:
The time has come, yet again, to make another deal with Lysenko.

And, just as before, there are those in the Brigade who say we should press the mad scientist for more. More guns. More training. More everything. But we won't. We have enough enemies right now without adding the Black Mountain to them, and we will make it known that we will honor deals when it suits us.

So that's what we'll do. One more deal. As fair as any one that can be had in the Southern Urals.

directives.title: Просите в два раза больше
directives.description: Лысенко явно что-то прячет, и старается себя не выдавать, поэтому давайте посмотрим, что нам удастся разузнать.
directives.description_en:
The time has come, yet again, to make another deal with Lysenko.

And, just as before, there are those in the Brigade who say we should press the mad scientist for more. More guns. More training. More everything. Why wouldn't we? He must have more in there then he is letting on, regardless of how much we've squeezed out of him so far. Let's see how much we can get out of the Black Mountain's stockpiles this time.

And also see how much he has left, before the point where he's no longer useful.

directives.title: Уничтожение Лиги
directives.description: Мы не можем больше позволить себе топтаться на месте, в то время как проклятая пидористическая Лига по-прежнему остается безмятежной. Ночью все на налет!
directives.description_en:
It is time. Finally, after so many raids, and so many battles, it is time.

We have been preparing to destroy the Ural League for a very long while, and it is now time to march. And we will not be content with the plunder of filthy villages, no, we will not stop until all of their fortresses are aflame, all of their fighters are dead or scattered, and all of their wealth and women are collected. We will not stop until the League is nothing more than a memory.

And once they are gone, the fun can really begin.

directives.title: Пиррова Победа
directives.description: Урал горит, но никто не празднует. Лысенко заявил, что горы принадлежат ему, и проигнорировал наши требования предоставить первые права на всю добычу Лиги. Нам придется сжечь все, что мы не сможем с собой унести, и мы будем проклинать его имя, пока он не засунет этот лут себе в жопу!
directives.description_en:
The Ural League is defeated, and the mountains are set aflame, but there is no celebration.

Lysenko, that traitorous madman, has claimed the mountains for his own, and ignored our demands for the loot rightfully earned in fire and blood. Though some in the Brigade want to avenge this insult immediately, we are in no position to fight him right now. We will take what we can, and leave, for now.

But we will not forget. And Lysenko will pay the only price that can be paid for denying a raider his plunder.

directives.title: Разделяй и Властвуй
directives.description: Лига была сокрушена нашей мощью! Восточная Венеция пала!Берите их ценности! Жгите и грабьте!
directives.description_en:
The League is crushed!

Their former lands, and all the people within them, are wide open for plunder. There is no longer anyone to stand in our way, and we can now have our fun. Take their valuables, abduct their women, kill anyone who stands or has stood against us, and burn their villages.

Burn it all!

directives.title: Мородерьте их крепости
directives.description: Их крепости пусты, хваленая Гвардия разбежалась, пока мы были в дороге. Берите все что не приколочено и жгите к хуям это место!
directives.description_en:
The Ural League's fortresses were, until now, almost unassailable. No longer.

With the League scattered, their former strongholds are wide open, and having been so untouched for so long, are packed with weapons, money, and much, much more. It's time to collect.

We'll take everything that isn't bolted down, and burn the rest as an example!

directives.title: Погоня за объедками
directives.description: Этот кусок дерьма Лысенко украл у нас Урал! Мы отомстим. Сладкое, сладкое возмездие этим ученых, дрочащих на кучу пробирок в их гребаной горе. До тех пор, однако, мы будем строить планы и не показывать как мы их ненавидим.
directives.description_en:
Lysenko, that bastard, stole the Urals from us.

Both he, and every one of the mad 'scientists' who follow him will pay for it. Dearly. Until then, however, we will concentrate on what we can still salvage from this betrayal. The remnants of the League are still present, either attempting flight or milling around in confusion, and we can recover some loot from their remains.

But we will, in time, get back what is rightfully ours.

directives.title: Гони трусов прочь
directives.description: Смотрите как они бегут! Они такие очаровательные, прям как поросята! Удар в ночи, наполнит их сердца ужасом! Возьмите их детей, вырежьте их мужиков, и насилуйте их женщин! Дайте им почуствовать, как мы их поимели!
directives.description_en:
The people run. Like the prey they are.

With the League fallen, countless thousands of those formerly under their protection try to escape, in any direction they can, and carrying anything of value that they possess. It's time to strike. In the night, we will descend upon them. We will kill their men, take their children, and use their women however we want. Let the survivors, few as they are, spread fear far and wide.

Fear of us.

directives.title: Мародерство Оренбурга
directives.description: Эти трусливые Русские свиньи кинули свой уютный Оренбург! Они - единственная вещь стоящая перед нами и пред великими богатыми полями России! Если не хочешь оказаться нашим рабом, мразь, отдавай все что есть!
directives.description_en:
Orenburg stands as the sole remaining obstacle between the Brigade and great Russian hunting grounds to the west.

It is time to destroy it. We will descend upon their communes, shatter their defenses, kill anyone who opposes us, take everything they have, and use what remains of their settlements as bases for further raiding farther afield.

We are so close to our goals, and we will achieve them.

directives.title: Мы перевернули их мирок
directives.description: Мы перевернули их уютный мирок, в сторону суровой русской реальности! Спалите тут все ДО ТЛА! Теперь мы здесь сила, а не трусливые демократы!
directives.description_en:
We've done it!

The perfect little world that the anarchists were building in Orenburg has been turned upside down. By us. By taking what we want. We reign supreme here, not the anarchists, or democrats, or whatever they called themselves. And we'll show them what we think of them - after we take what we want, we'll burn their city to the ground.

Let it burn, all of it!

directives.title: Окропите Землю
directives.description: Ваши люди, отныне наши люди! Они бесполезны на своей работе! Что же, пора окропить землю кровью! Жги все! Они либо будут служить нам, либо голодать!
directives.description_en:
We've taken everything from Orenburg. Including their crops.

And now that we have them, we can make sure that they can't get any more. We'll salt what fields we can, and burn the rest. Without any way to secure their own food supply, not only can they never rise against us again, but they'll also have to make a decision.

They'll serve us. Or they'll starve. It's their choice.

directives.title: Собирайте вещички
directives.description: Берите все, что не приколочено! Любая вещь станет вашей, лишь по вашему хотению! И если хоть кто-то рыпнется, гасите его!
directives.description_en:
Orenburg, its lands, and everything within them, is ours.

The Brigade will take everything that isn't bolted down, dig up any pathetic attempts at concealment, choose the women we want to carry away, and identify the men we think most able to be pressed into service.

And if anyone resists? Shoot them.

directives.title: Пусть все познают страх
directives.description: Они боятся нас, так как понимают за что мы стоим! Мы будем чудовищами для них в их сказках для их детей, и в сказках для их внуков, по всей России!
directives.description_en:
Fear is just as powerful a weapon as any rifle.

After all our conquests, all our raids, all our victories, and all our secured plunder, fear both precedes and follows us, as well it should. All across Russia, we are the monster in the night. We are the boogeyman. We are the name, the visage, that men fear and that women tell whispered stories about to frighten their children.

We are fear incarnate. And all will know it.

directives.title: Один Последний Рубеж
directives.description: Все, кто здесь были, пали у наших ног; Кто же еще кроме нашего недавнего друга Лысенко? Все они попрятались в своих горах как дети в комнате, это не должно быть особо трудной задачей! Теперь нужно лишь немного подготовиться перед походом в гости...
directives.description_en:
We have crushed Orenburg. We have scattered the Ural League to the winds. Only one enemy remains: Lysenko.

The madman of the Black Mountain, a former benefactor turned traitor, who thinks that his defenses and his soldiers and his insane experiments will protect him from our wrath.

He is wrong. And we will begin preparing the means by which to show him.

directives.title: Царь Горы
directives.description: Время приходит, братья, для атаки на гору товарища Лысенко. Он восседал там слишком долго, мне кажется он наигрался в свои эксперименты. Он же не сможет представлять сильную угрозу, так ведь?
directives.description_en:
The time has come to ride on the Black Mountain.

Lysenko thinks he is safe. He is wrong. We will scatter the few soldiers still loyal to him, destroy whatever cursed experiments he might be able to send at us, and drag him and his other scientists out of their labs and into the real world. He cannot resist us. He cannot pose much of a threat.

Can he?

directives.title: Собаки лают, а налет идет
directives.title_en: Alexander Wept, but We Will Ride
directives.description: Мы новые македонцы, а я Александр! Могучая степь с ее богатствами раскинулась перед нами! Сейчас мы княжим и грабим, прям как великие греки!
directives.description_en:
The Brigade has ascended, from a collection of raiders to the new Macedonians.

We rule Orsk. We rule the Urals. The steppe lies open to us, and now we ride, and conquer, like the Greeks of old, with our very own Alexander leading us forever forward to wine, women, and riches uncountable!

The reputation we have built here will only grow, because not a man, woman, or child will be safe. We will torch Germania, plunder New York, sack Tokyo, and take everything we want, everything we see.

The King, and his bandits, ride!
